# N.O.K Social

> N.O.K Social is a marketing and web studio that helps startups and growing businesses worldwide. It plans marketing strategy and campaigns around research and data, and builds custom websites (booking, online ordering, payments, customer data) and affordable business toolkits so founders can automate their marketing and focus on running the business. Founded by Nicholas Osei Kofi Asare, based in Ghana, working with clients anywhere.

## About

- Founder: Nicholas Osei Kofi Asare (BSc International Business, MSc Business and Data Analytics). "NOK" is short for his name.
- Focus: startups, so the marketing and operational foundations are right from day one.
- Approach: research first (market research, audience profiling, customer language), strategy before posting, and analytics that shape every campaign. Digital marketing is treated as real marketing done online, not just social media management.

## Services

- [Marketing](https://noksocial.com/services/marketing): brand setup, shop and Google setup, monthly marketing (content, social media and reporting), and ad campaigns.
- [Websites](https://noksocial.com/services/websites): custom websites at the heart of the business, with online booking, orders and payments (card and mobile money), automatic email/SMS updates and customer data. Business toolkits are the affordable first step: automations built with tools like Google Sheets, Forms and Apps Script, with an upgrade path to a full website. Clients own the code and domain after the build. Builds take at least 4 weeks depending on scope; optional monthly maintenance is available after launch.
- [All services](https://noksocial.com/services)

Work starts with a free discovery call, then a written proposal. A 40% deposit starts the work and the balance is paid on completion.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://noksocial.com/): what N.O.K Social does, client work and how projects run.

- [Free tools](https://noksocial.com/resources): free templates, including a leads management tracker.
- [Instagram health check](https://noksocial.com/ighealthcheck): a free Instagram profile audit tool in development, with a waitlist.
